sources.text: Welcome to the Toor Lab! We investigate the relationship between RNA structure and biology. We use tools ranging from cryo-EM to single-molecule fluorescence. In addition, we also use organic chemistry to expand the universe of chemical modifications that can be added to RNA for therapeutics. This site was created with the Nicepage

Welcome to the Toor Lab! We investigate the relationship between RNA structure and biology. We use tools ranging from cryo-EM to single-molecule fluorescence. In addition, we also use organic chemistry to expand the universe of chemical modifications that can be added to RNA for therapeutics. This site was created with the Nicepage
